class.name: PocketAR
class.brief_description: Shared AR session enums and explicit-packet geometry helpers.
class.description: Use the PocketAR singleton. Games normally use ARView for session controls and presented-frame placement. The geometry helpers are advanced: the caller chooses the packet and is responsible for generation and presentation checks. Camera axes are +X right, +Y up, -Z forward; world units are metres.

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns the primary XR backend name: none, synthetic, scripted, arcore, arkit, or unknown for another provider. ARView.backend instead uses the ARView.Backend enum.

method.name: get_version
method.description: Returns the PocketAR library version string.

method.name: raycast_planes
method.description: Advanced explicit-packet intersection using ray.origin and ray.direction in world space. Returns copied hits nearest first, or [code][][/code] for no hit, an invalid ray or a null/untracked packet. Intersects tracking, unsubsumed polygon front faces. Does not validate ray IDs against the packet or the current session.

method.name: screen_to_ray
method.description: Advanced explicit-packet ray from top-left-origin viewport pixels. Returns origin (world near-plane point in metres), direction (unit world vector), frame_id and session_generation. Returns {} for a null/untracked packet or nonpositive viewport size. Does not check whether the packet is presented or belongs to the current generation.
